hypothesis: In parallelCandidates() and supported(), scoring uncollapsed 4-word phrases with frames.nll() causes a severe CTC length-squeeze artifact whenever fast/normal recitation has fewer frames than uncollapsed 4-symbol madd/ghunna runs and the written word has an extra repeated-token blank (e.g. e72f9fb1 22:1:3 ittaqu vs u'budu: +41.37 nats raw vs -33.56 nats collapsed). Also switchedClarity() returns 1.0 when zero heard phones miss written and match alt, lowering the bar to PHRASE_SWITCH without acoustic support. Collapsing held madd/ghunna runs via collapseHeld() in parallel phrase CTC scoring and returning 0 from switchedClarity() when on.length === 0 fixes the 22:1:3 false warning without regressing lab practice or help eval.
